applicability_limits: The sharp L reference and all eight holes are retained for this load-law construction. The separate ideal Ri=t bend stress construction is not a mapped formed-solid domain or complete fitting/contact qualification.

Nominal solid shafts, hex heads, bored hex nuts, two washers and eight spacers define gravity distributions only. Partial-thread shank/root geometry, head/shaft continuity, nut engagement and their mechanical compliance remain to define; full-thread-root sensitivity stays non-adopted.

The 66 other timber metal-share forces still need finite attachment distributions; 217 panel actions per case retain reduced panel work pending bulk coupling. Hillman resistance/stiffness is not inferred from other screws.

Matching resultants and enclosing affine differences does not preserve arbitrary old beam/modal work or transfer old comparator bounds. A symmetric-prism control has identical centroid work but different quadratic virtual work.

The complete contact search, all interacting load/constitutive/fracture laws, mesh/integration convergence, directional restraint and the common coupled evaluation remain open. Do not add old bedding/capture stiffness in parallel with resolved bulk compliance.

Panel/screw exceedances remain deferred; actual build fit is excluded; no observations, design revision, floor-friction test, physical work, native/global/frame/contact-equilibrium solve, optimization, inverse matrix or factorization is supplied. All three full qualifications remain open.
engineering_question: Define bounded uniform volume gravity work on retained sharp-reference fittings, nominal metal roles and recorded numerical timber moment domains, keeping every source resultant and explicitly enclosing the affine first-moment differences. This is preparation for the coupled model, not a response or resistance result.

load_law.boundedness: For V_D>0, |L_D(v)| <= |F_D|/sqrt(V_D) * ||v||_L2(D). The recorded square |F_D|^2/V_D is an L2 functional norm, not complementary strain energy or a stiffness/capacity bound. Numerical timber moments require a future consistent integration check.
load_law.definition: For each domain D in the reference configuration, L_D(v)=F_D dot integral_D v dV / V_D, V_D=integral_D 1 dV. Gravity is a fixed downward dead load per reference volume. Its potential is -L_D(u); no follower-force rotation is applied.
load_law.domains: 530 analytic metal domains: 22 sharp eight-hole L fittings and 508 nominal shaft/head/nut/washer/spacer roles. Use the retained chart x=o+sum_i a_i xi_i and its positive determinant, without silently assuming stored axes have exact unit length. The 22 finished timbers use authenticated saved numerical volume/centroid moments and their pinned BREP domains; this is a numerical moment contract, not exact geometric integral certification. Observed versus older metadata volumes are separately compared under the existing 1e-5 mm^3 numerical gate used by eoere_cleat_surface_loads.uniform_gravity; use the observed numerical volume and retain the difference. This gate does not certify exact geometry integration.
load_law.moments: Uniform loading has centroid C_D=integral_D x dV/V_D. The exact difference on v=a+B*x is sum_ij F_i B_ij (C_j-p_source,j); every coefficient is enclosed and kept as a load-mapping discrepancy. First moments are not asserted exactly equal. The 1e-7 mm source consistency gate is a recorded numerical mapping gate, not physical tolerances or a bound on arbitrary deformation work.
load_law.normalization: Use each recorded source force exactly once, rather than recomputing mass times gravity or adding density-derived weight. Catalog fitting mass remains the basis even though its normalized density differs from bulk steel.

primary_method.scope: Bower 8.1 supplies body-force virtual work. Shape integrals, dyadic interval bounds, chart Jacobians and source-work comparisons are project derivations. This does not transfer a nonlinear contact or fracture algorithm.
